According to the conversation provided, Jake and LiHua plan to meet at a park for their soccer practice. The meeting is scheduled for Saturday at 3 PM, as confirmed in the exchange:

```plaintext
JakeWatson: Awesome! Let’s meet at the park on Saturday at 3 PM. It’ll be great to work on some shots together! Bring your A-game! 🙌⚽️
LiHua: Got it! I'll be there at 3 PM. Looking forward to it! Let’s score some goals! ⚽️👍
```

The park serves as the suitable and agreed-upon location for them to work on soccer drills, specifically focusing on shooting skills, as mentioned by Jake. No further details on an indoor location such as a basement are provided for the soccer practice; they only reference a basement in a separate conversation about a guitar jam session.
